subject: Post-demo privacy handoff and legal asks — Finova
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@finova.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo recap & privacy handoff — Finova

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the time today — really appreciated the candid conversation about where Finova is headed on data classification and privacy. As promised, quick recap and items we flagged that your legal/procurement team will likely need: 

- SOC 2 status: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II; attaching a 1‑page summary for procurement (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf).
- DPA & SCCs: We can support both controller/processor configurations. From the call it sounded like Finova prefers Redwood to be a processor, but legal asked for a DPA that shows both options so they can choose the SCC module that maps to their flow.
- HIPAA: Our hosted product can be configured to support PHI workflows when customers engage our Private/enterprise package; we can share the HIPAA attestation summary if helpful.
- Security questionnaire: you mentioned sending over your vendor security questionnaire — please share it and we’ll kick off the intake. I’ve attached the copy you uploaded in the demo (finova-security-questionnaire.pdf) for reference.

Next steps I propose:
1) Elena, please confirm whether legal wants Redwood explicitly documented as Processor in the initial DPA or if they want a two‑option DPA (Controller | Processor) for their counsel to decide.
2) If Procurement wants a procurement-side checklist, loop in procurement@finova.com and we’ll put together an intake packet (SOC2 summary, DPA template, evidence list).
3) Neha (legal), Jordan (SE) and I will triage the questionnaire as soon as Elena/procurement send it.

Attaching: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (stub), finova-security-questionnaire.pdf (stub)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a concise timeline once Elena confirms procurement contact.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Finova Procurement <procurement@finova.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap & privacy handoff — Finova

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap and the SOC2 summary — helpful. 

A few clarifications from our side:
- On DPA roles: Our privacy team typically expects vendors to be Processor, but our legal team requests DPA language that makes it straightforward to flip if our workload changes. So a DPA that provides both processor and controller language (or a modular approach with SCC module selection) would be ideal.
- SCC preference: We don’t require a bespoke SCC; our counsel prefers the EU Commission Model Clauses as implemented via a Processor-friendly module when the vendor is Processor. If Redwood can indicate the SCC module mapping (Processor vs Controller) in the DPA front page, that will speed review.
- SOC2: Procurement asked for the most recent auditor/period — the one you attached is good but can you also include the auditor name and coverage dates?
- Questionnaire: attaching our vendor security questionnaire (the same doc you referenced) — procurement will expect a 2–3 business day turnaround for high-level answers, and 7–10 business days for detailed evidence.

Procurement (cc): please advise if you need a DocuSign-ready DPA or if we should start with a working Google Doc.

Elena
Head of Privacy, Finova
elena@finova.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@finova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T18:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap & privacy handoff — Finova

Elena / team,

Thanks — looped in Jordan and I’ll lead on the DPA/SCC mapping. Quick answers and ask list: 

1) SOC 2 details: Auditor: Brightline Assurance LLP; Coverage: 01-01-2026 to 06-30-2026. I’ll attach the auditor cover letter in the intake packet.
2) DPA approach: We can produce a single DPA that contains optional SCC module mapping and a front page checkbox indicating the chosen role (Processor or Controller). That mirrors what you described (modular).
3) Evidence & timeline: We can provide high-level questionnaire responses in 48 business hours for the sections marked ‘Tier 1’ (org + controls). For deeper evidence (documents, screenshots, service logs) we’ll need 7–10 business days depending on scope.

Please confirm the procurement contact and preferred initial doc format (Google Doc or DocuSign). Once procurement confirms, Jordan and I will triage the specific questionnaire sections and produce an intake packet.

Related links for procurement/legal: 
- DPA template (internal): https://drive.google.com/redwood/dpa-template
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@finova.com>, Finova Procurement <procurement@finova.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-31T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap & privacy handoff — Finova

Thanks everyone — short action plan and timeline from our side: 

1) Procurement format: Elena/procurement, please confirm by EOD today whether you prefer a Google Doc draft or DocuSign-ready DPA. If no reply, we will share the Google Doc draft by tomorrow EOD to speed review.
2) Intake packet (owner: Neha): Redwood will share the DPA draft + SCC module notes + SOC2 cover letter within 48 business hours of procurement format confirmation. (Target: Nov 2 EOD if format confirmed today).
3) Questionnaire triage (owner: Jordan): Jordan will split the questionnaire into Tier 1 (quick answers) and Tier 2 (evidence requests) and return Tier 1 answers within 2 business days of receiving the confirmed format.
4) Commercials & procurement steps (owner: Vivek): Vivek will follow up on DocuSign/PO timeline and coordinate with procurement for signature routing.

If that works, I’ll send a short calendar invite for a 20‑minute legal/procurement sync early next week to walk through the draft.

Best,
Marissa
